reason: lib/topic_retriever.rb:27-28 calls `$redis.setnx(retrieved_key, "1")` and then a separate `$redis.expire(retrieved_key, 60)`, so a crash or Redis error between them leaves the key with no TTL and `retrieved_recently?` returns true indefinitely for that URL. Only staff (`no_throttle`, app/jobs/regular/retrieve_topic.rb:17) bypass it, so "permanently" holds for ordinary users until the key is deleted by hand.
